projects.title: Novoprotein, Web
projects.description: Following our brand refresh for Novoprotein, I designed desktop and mobile homepage demonstrations for the client’s team to extend. The scope is a homepage at 1440 px and 390 px, showing how the identity works with product browsing and company information.
paragraphs: 在共同完成近岸蛋白的品牌升级后，我设计了桌面与手机端首页示范，供客户团队继续延展。设计范围为 1440 px 与 390 px 两种首页，展示品牌系统如何承接产品浏览与公司信息。

sections.title: Product discovery
paragraphs: Search, category navigation and featured product cards offer different starting points. The page continues through research applications, technical support, company information and news before reaching the enquiry form.
搜索、分类导航与重点产品卡片提供不同的浏览入口。页面随后呈现研究应用、技术支持、公司介绍与新闻，最后连接咨询表单。

sections.title: From identity to interface
paragraphs: Geometric headlines sit alongside readable body text. Orange highlights key actions, while scientific illustrations connect the opening section, product categories and supporting content. Type, colour and component rules connect desktop and mobile.
几何感标题与易读的正文搭配。橙色强调关键操作，科学插画贯穿首屏、产品分类与辅助内容。字体、色彩和组件规范维持桌面与手机端的一致性。

sections.title: Web components
paragraphs: Buttons, navigation, product cards, news modules and enquiry fields extend the brand system into repeatable interface elements. Navigation, card grids and forms adapt their arrangement for narrower screens.
按钮、导航、产品卡片、新闻模块与咨询字段，将品牌系统延伸为可重复使用的界面元素。导航、卡片网格与表单根据较窄的屏幕调整排列。

projects.title: Novoprotein, Visual Identity
projects.description: At N/A Design, we refreshed Novoprotein’s visual identity for its expansion into the North American market. The work connects a refined wordmark, typography, colour and scientific illustrations in one system, with guidance and templates for consistent use.
paragraphs: 在 N/A Design，我们共同完成近岸蛋白面向北美市场的品牌视觉升级，将调整后的字标、字体、色彩与科学插画整合为统一系统，并通过规范与模板支持后续使用。

sections.title: Starting points
paragraphs: Our review identified three areas to develop: the English wordmark’s standalone readability, a wider supporting palette, and a more consistent illustration style across existing materials. These became the starting points for the refresh.
前期梳理明确了三个可继续发展的方向：英文标志单独使用时的可读性、更丰富的辅助色，以及不同物料间更一致的插画风格。品牌更新由此展开。

sections.title: Wordmark and colour
paragraphs: Spacing and curve adjustments preserve the wordmark’s recognisable character. Brand Orange remains the main colour, supported by blue, warm secondary colours and neutrals for different levels of information.
通过字距与曲线调整，保留原字标的识别特征。品牌橙继续作为主色，蓝色、暖色辅助色与中性色支持不同的信息层级。

sections.title: Typography and layout
paragraphs: Orbitron Bold gives headlines and numbers a geometric character. IBM Plex Serif supports subtitles and labels, while Noto Sans handles body text. Type size, leading and spacing define the hierarchy across layouts.
Orbitron Bold 用于具有几何特征的标题与数字，IBM Plex Serif 承接副标题和标签，Noto Sans 用于正文。字号、行距与间距共同建立不同版式中的信息层级。

sections.title: Scientific illustrations
paragraphs: Ribbon, solid and translucent forms create a shared visual language for biological subjects. A reusable AI prompt defines shape, colour, transparency and depth. Generated images are reviewed and refined for consistency before becoming brand assets.
飘带、实体与半透明形态为生物主题建立统一的视觉语言。可复用的 AI 提示词规定形态、色彩、透明度与空间层次，生成图像再经过人工审核与调整，成为一致的品牌素材。

sections.title: Presentation templates
paragraphs: Presentation templates carry the system into covers, section pages, text, images and data. Reusable layouts define how typography, colour and scientific visuals work together across different kinds of content.
演示模板将系统延伸至封面、章节页、正文、图片与数据内容。可复用的版式规定字体、色彩与科学图像如何搭配，以承接不同类型的信息。

projects.title: uxoffice®: uxtester
projects.description: uxtester® is a usability-testing tool within ISAR’s uxoffice® suite. It brings test preparation, live observation, recordings and analysis into one project.
paragraphs: During my internship at ISAR, I was responsible for the version 2 interface. Working from the UX team’s prototypes, I developed the page structure, visual hierarchy and shared components, and worked with developers on implementation.
uxtester® 是 ISAR uxoffice® 工具集中的可用性测试工具，将测试准备、实时观察、录制与分析放在同一项目中。
在 ISAR 实习期间，我负责第二版产品的界面设计。基于 UX 团队的原型，我梳理页面分区、视觉层级与通用组件，并与开发团队协作落地。

sections.title: Prepare, observe and review
paragraphs: Scenarios, tasks and questions form the test script. During a session, researchers follow multiple camera feeds and mark issues with timestamps. Recordings, grouped issues and selected clips support later review.
通过场景、任务和问题组织测试脚本。测试过程中，研究人员查看多路画面，并用时间标记记录问题；测试后再回看录制、归纳问题与整理精选片段。

sections.title: From UX handoff to interface
paragraphs: The UX team’s report prototypes connect data tables, page flows and interaction notes. The original canvases show the scope of the screens and states developed from this handoff.
UX 团队的报告原型将数据表格、页面流程与交互说明联系起来。原稿画布总览呈现由此展开的界面、组件分组与交互状态；截图保留设计文件中的示例内容。

sections.title: Shared components
paragraphs: The shared library brings together type, colour, icons and controls used across uxoffice®. It covers forms, navigation, recording controls, account emails and illustrations, with states for different tasks.
组件库集中呈现 uxoffice® 使用的字体、色彩、图标与控件，覆盖表单和导航，也包含录制控件、账号邮件与插画，以及不同任务下的界面状态。

sections.title: Account emails
paragraphs: The email layouts cover team invitations, verification codes and password-reset confirmations. A shared logo, reading column and support footer connect these messages to the product.
邮件版式覆盖团队邀请、验证码与密码重置确认。统一的标志、正文栏与反馈页脚，让这些账号通知与产品保持一致。

projects.title: Bull User Echo
projects.description: Bull User Echo is an experience-data platform commissioned by Bull. It organises product reviews into dashboards, categories and alerts, helping teams explore feedback and return to the comments behind a theme.
paragraphs: At ISAR, I independently designed the overall interface and data visualisation, covering overviews, dashboards, analysis, alerts and permissions. I also followed the designs through implementation with developers.
Bull User Echo 是公牛委托的体验数据分析平台，通过数据看板、评价分类和预警组织产品反馈，方便团队比较不同产品，并从评价主题回到具体评论。
在 ISAR，我独立负责整体界面与数据可视化设计，覆盖信息概览、数据看板、分析、预警及权限管理，并跟进开发实现。

sections.title: Overview and comparison
paragraphs: Review volume, sentiment and trends share one overview. Filters narrow the product scope, while comparison tables place selected products and their feedback side by side.
概览页面汇总评价数量、态度倾向与变化趋势。通过筛选缩小产品范围，再将选中的产品放入对比表，查看产品信息与评价差异。

sections.title: Drill-down analysis
paragraphs: Selecting a bar opens the next level of subdimensions and related products. Word clouds connect review topics with related comments, keeping each summary linked to its source text.
点击柱图后逐层展开子维度及相关产品，选中状态保留当前分析路径。词云将评价主题与相关评论对应起来，让汇总信息与原始文字保持联系。

sections.title: Alerts
paragraphs: The alert centre combines rule settings, recipients and triggered items. Opening an item shows related products and review details, so users can inspect what triggered the alert.
预警中心包含规则设置、接收人和已触发的预警列表。打开一条预警后，可以查看相关产品与评价详情，了解触发原因。

sections.title: Chart and interface states
paragraphs: Filters, tables, chart tooltips and word-cloud states follow shared visual rules. The component views show selection, hover and navigation across the analysis pages.
筛选、表格、图表提示与词云状态沿用统一的视觉规则。组件图展示了选中、悬停和导航在各类分析页面中的对应关系。

projects.title: The Red Pack
projects.description: The Red Pack is a fictional Mars suitcase designed to enhance passengers' experience during their 7-month journey to Mars. Beyond its basic storage and transportation functions, it simulates life on Mars and features a planting module to adjust moods. At the journey's end, plants can be transplanted to Mars, symbolizing environmental transformation. This project explores how humans might adapt to extended interstellar travel and new living conditions in uncharted territories.
paragraphs: The Red Pack 是为七个月火星旅程设想的行李箱。除收纳与运输外，它还加入种植模块，模拟火星生活并调节旅途情绪。旅程结束后，植物可以移植到火星。这个概念借此探讨人们如何适应漫长的星际旅行与新的生活环境。

projects.title: Urban Interactions, UABB
projects.description: Urbanism/Architecture Bi-City Biennale (UABB) is a cultural platform whose main objective is to bring together leading voices in design to discuss issues impacting architecture in modern-day society. UABB is forward-thinking and focuses on the conceptual problems of urbanism and architecture.
paragraphs: This personal project aims to redesign the overall graphic language of the Bi-City Biennale of Urbanism/Architecture Exhibition (UABB) by establishing and using an online visual information library based on the city's sound. Allowing audiences and users to experience sound through graphics, comparing the differences in sound in different cities and regions, forming a sound-based perception of the city.
深港城市／建筑双城双年展（UABB）是讨论当代城市与建筑议题的文化平台。这个个人项目以城市声音为线索，重新设计展览的视觉语言，并建立线上视觉资料库。观众可以通过图形感受、比较不同城市与区域的声音，以另一种方式理解城市。

projects.title: Optech Museum
projects.description: The Optech Museum is an imaginary science museum brand, dedicated to showcasing optical instruments from early centuries to future possibilities. It provides a technical and cultural-historical survey of the development of optical instruments and science. The museum houses a rich collection that traces the history of technological advancement.
paragraphs: Optech Museum 是一个虚构的科学博物馆品牌，以从早期到未来的光学仪器为展示主题。项目从技术与文化史两个角度梳理光学仪器的发展，并通过馆藏呈现科学与技术的演变。

projects.title: LDTX
projects.description: BeijingDance/LDTX (LDTX) is a privately run professional dance company, co-founded in 2005 by Willy TSAO and LI Hanzhong. The company engages in all aspects of creation, performance, education, and outreach programs, providing a platform where Chinese artists can freely express their latest ideologies and sentiments, thereby advancing the multifaceted development of dance. This project aims to use pure typography to simulate the dancers' gestures and movements, and based on this concept, create the visual language and logo of the dance company.
paragraphs: LDTX 是一家成立于 2005 年的民营专业舞团，开展创作、演出、教育与推广活动。这个项目用字体形态模拟舞者的姿态和动作，并由此设计舞团的视觉语言与标志。

projects.title: John Cage 4′33″
projects.description: Music exists in the space between notes. John Cage challenged traditional notation with interpretive approaches. The 4′33″ booklet uses pure typography to capture the essence of his work, inspired by his performance 4′33″.
paragraphs: 这本受约翰·凯奇《4′33″》启发的小册以纯字体排版，回应作品对音乐、记谱与聆听的重新思考。
